description: Consolidated AMD2 targeting-signal scorecard across all nine signal classes tested
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os, json

rows = [
 ("PTS1 (C-terminal tripeptide)","-SKI","matches permissive consensus only; fails strict [SAC][KRH][LM] (Ile at -1)",
  "WEAK / likely coincidental", 0.25),
 ("PTS1 ortholog conservation","13 distinct tripeptides in 19 Saccharomycetaceae orthologs; C-term/flank identity ratio 0.87",
  "peroxisomal controls median 1.27, cytosolic median 0.90 (MWU p=0.027)","NOT a conserved signal", 0.10),
 ("PTS1 proteome prior","permissive-PTS1 terminus PPV 7.1% (33/465); strict PPV 60% (18/30)",
  "other yeast -SKI proteins RLM1, NSA1 are nuclear/nucleolar (0/2 peroxisomal)","NOT informative", 0.07),
 ("PTS2 (N-terminal nonapeptide)","none","0 matches to strict (R/K)(L/V/I/Q)XX(L/V/I/H/Q)(L/S/G/A/K)X(H/Q)(L/A/F) in whole protein","ABSENT", 0.0),
 ("Mitochondrial presequence","absent","0 Arg in residues 1-30, 4 acidic residues, first at position 9, helical moment 0.387 (<0.45)","ABSENT", 0.0),
 ("Signal peptide","absent","max Kyte-Doolittle(19) in residues 1-40 = -0.76, far below the 1.6 h-region threshold","ABSENT", 0.0),
 ("Transmembrane segment","absent","0 windows with KD(19) > 1.6 across 549 aa; FAAH1/FAAH2/AMI1 have 5/8/7","ABSENT", 0.0),
 ("Nuclear localization signal","absent","no monopartite or bipartite match; max K/R fraction in any 20-aa window 0.35","ABSENT", 0.0),
 ("Lipid anchor","absent","residue 2 is Thr (no N-myristoylation); C-terminal FSKI is not a CAAX box","ABSENT", 0.0),
]
S = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["signal_class","observation","basis","verdict","confidence_signal_present"])
pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",95); pd.set_option("display.width",400)
print(S.to_string(index=False))
S.to_csv("amd2_targeting_signal_scorecard.csv", index=False)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5,5.2))
y=np.arange(len(S))[::-1]
cols=["#d1495b" if v>=0.2 else ("#f0a500" if v>0.0 else "#7fb069") for v in S.confidence_signal_present]
ax.barh(y, S.confidence_signal_present.clip(lower=0.012), color=cols, height=0.62)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(S.signal_class, fontsize=9.5)
ax.set_xlim(0,1); ax.set_xlabel("estimated probability that this targeting signal is present and functional")
ax.set_title("AMD2 (P22580) targeting-signal scorecard\nonly the C-terminal -SKI scores above zero, and ortholog and proteome tests argue it is coincidental",
             fontsize=11)
for yy,(v,verd) in zip(y, zip(S.confidence_signal_present,S.verdict)):
    ax.text(max(v,0.012)+0.015, yy, verd, va="center", fontsize=8.5, color="#333")
[ax.spines[s].set_visible(False) for s in ("top","right")]
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("\nfiles written to the executor working directory:")
for f in sorted(os.listdir(".")):
    if f.endswith((".csv",".fasta")): print("  ", f, os.path.getsize(f), "bytes")
